profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company headquartered in Dublin and traded under the ticker ACN. Its website describes the firm as embracing the power of change to create 360-degree value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. It says it works across industries and around the world to create better experiences using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

The site's AI-related material covers the Human + AI era, including redesigning work, accelerating skills and reinventing HR so people and AI work together. It also discusses AI tokenomics, AI ROI and enterprise AI economics, power demand from AI and a power-first strategy for data center developers, and cyber resilience in an AI-driven threat landscape. Accenture states it is helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations. No specific AI product names appear in the provided material.

The available record lists no litigation involving Accenture. As a public company, it has SEC CIK number 0001467373.
